jobs.title: Intern Software Enginner
jobs.description:
Company Overview
IRIX Solutions is a dynamic and innovative technology company committed to delivering cutting-edge solutions to clients worldwide. We pride ourselves on fostering a collaborative and inclusive work environment where creativity and innovation thrive.
Position Overview
We are seeking a motivated and talented Intern Software Engineer to join our team. This is an exciting opportunity for individuals looking to gain hands-on experience in software development and work on impactful projects in a global setting.
Responsibilities
• Collaborate with the development team to design, develop, and test software applications.

• Assist in the creation and maintenance of both frontend and backend components.

• Contribute to the development of web applications using WordPress, React, and Next.js.

• Participate in the development of mobile applications using Flutter.

• Write clean, scalable, and efficient code in Java.

• Engage in code reviews and provide constructive feedback to peers.

• Stay updated with the latest industry trends and technologies.

Qualifications
• Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.

• 0-1 years of experience in software development.

• Basic understanding of frontend and backend development.

• Familiarity with WordPress, React, Flutter, and Next.js.

• Strong problem-solving skills and attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.

Why Join IRIX Solutions?
• Gain valuable experience working on real-world projects.

• Collaborate with a diverse and talented team of professionals.

• Opportunity to learn and grow in a supportive environment.

• Be part of a company that values innovation and creativity.

jobs.title: Growth Marketing & Outreach Intern
jobs.description:
Own the outreach engine behind Vistara's growth.

Vistara Ventures is an operator-led investment and company-building firm. We work with

founders, CEOs, investors, operators and mentors around companies that need more than

capital. We bring together capital, senior operators, product and engineering capability, and

hands-on execution.

We are looking for a highly organised, commercially curious junior marketer who can identify the

right people, start strong conversations and turn those conversations into qualified meetings for

the founder.

Responsibilities:

Research and identify investors, founders, startups, mentors, operators, CEOs and business owners relevant to Vistara.

• Build segmented outreach lists and keep prospect data accurate, organised and current.

• Run daily outreach through LinkedIn, email, phone, WhatsApp and other appropriate channels.

• Write concise, professional outreach messages and adapt them by audience and campaign.

• Follow up consistently, qualify interest and escalate strong opportunities quickly.

• Book meetings for the founder and manage invitations, confirmations, reminders and follow-ups.

• Support LinkedIn posts, social media activity, founder-led content and basic Canva execution.

• Track outreach performance, replies, meetings and conversion so campaigns can improve each week.

• Help organise investor, founder and mentor events, including invite lists, RSVPs and post-event follow-up.

• Prepare short meeting briefs, contact notes and CRM or spreadsheet updates after conversations.

• Support ad hoc research, coordination and founder-office tasks when priorities move quickly.

Who we are looking for:

• Fluent written and spoken English, with the confidence to communicate with senior professionals.

• Highly organised, detail-oriented and reliable with follow-up.

• Strong understanding of LinkedIn, social media and digital outreach.

• Commercial curiosity and genuine interest in startups, investing, business growth and entrepreneurship.

• Comfortable speaking by phone and writing concise professional messages.

• Able to work independently, move quickly and handle several priorities at once.

• Comfortable with Google Workspace, spreadsheets, Canva, ChatGPT and modern AI tools.

• Resilient enough to handle unanswered messages and rejection without losing momentum.

jobs.title: Intern - Branding
jobs.description:
John Keells Holdings PLC (JKH) is Sri Lanka's largest listed conglomerate in the Colombo Stock Exchange. From managing hotels and resorts in Sri Lanka and the Maldives to providing port, marine fuel and logistics services to IT solutions, manufacturing of food and beverages to running a chain of supermarkets, tea broking to stock broking, life insurance and banking to real estate, we have made our presence felt in virtually every major sphere of the economy.

Our business built over 150 years touches nearly every major sector of the economy. We generate a significant quantum of data, and we intend to use it to build the future of our businesses. Our Digital and Analytics insights can positively disrupt life for all Sri Lankans and our commitment to passion and excellence will help to deliver superior value to customers, our people, and the community.

OCTAVE is the cornerstone of our data-driven strategic and operational decisions!

Team OCTAVE solves JKH's most intractable problems across industry verticals by building pipelines using Python and Azure data factory to work on one of the country's richest data lakes, building and implementing complex machine learning algorithms that will impact millions of Sri Lankans.

Job Role

We’re seeking a driven and creative Branding Intern to lead impactful initiatives that shape our company’s identity both internally and externally. This role offers the rare opportunity to help with projects related to talent branding, social media strategy, content planning, internal communications, artwork design, and employee engagement. You’ll have the freedom to “show your colours” and leave a tangible mark on our brand—all while receiving mentorship from a team of seasoned experts.

Key Responsibilities:
• Help with the development and execution of internal/external branding campaigns.
• Help with talent branding initiatives to attract top-tier candidates.
• Create and implement social media strategies to amplify brand presence.
• Plan, curate, and schedule engaging content across digital platforms.
• Collaborate on internal communications to foster a cohesive company culture.
• Produce eye-catching artwork and design assets for social media and other internal events.
• Help to improve internal engagement through creative campaigns and events.

Qualifications:
• Creative powerhouse with a knack for storytelling and visual design.
• leadership experience (e.g., heading clubs, leading sports teams, organizing events).
• Self-starter with a high sense of responsibility and a results-driven mindset.
• Basic proficiency in design tools (Adobe Creative Suite, Canva) is a plus.
• Excellent communication skills and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

Why Join Us?
• Ownership & Impact: Enjoy autonomy to lead projects while shaping our brand’s future.
• Mentorship & Growth: Learn from a team of industry veterans committed to helping you succeed.
• Dynamic Environment: Collaborate with passionate professionals in a culture that values innovation.

John Keells Group is an equal-opportunity employer, and we invite applications from all suitably qualified individuals to join our team. By applying, you consent to the processing of your personal information for recruitment purposes and acknowledge that reference checks may be conducted.

Want to learn more about Octave? Check out https://www.octave.lk/

jobs.title: Corporate Relations Intern
jobs.description:
About Us

Abans PLC has held the dominant position in Sri Lanka's Consumer Durables market for over five decades, fostering a sense of recognition among the populace through its range of innovative, environmentally friendly, and technologically advanced yet user-friendly products and brands. Abans proudly represents renowned global brands across various categories such as Consumer Electronics, Home Appliances, Kitchen Appliances, Smart Devices, Laptops 6: Laptop Accessories, Furniture, Solar, and more. The company's longstanding partnership with LG Electronics Inc., Korea, a global leader in innovation and technology for over 35 years, has resulted in Abans being recognized as the top-performing Distributor in South East Asia. Acknowledged by esteemed global brands including LG, Apple, HP, Lenovo, Acer, Motorola, Oppo, Vivo, Realme, Toto, Elba, Haier, Harman Kardon, JBL, Marshall, and others, Abans has been appointed as their official partner in Sri Lanka. Abans has consistently led the market in Air Conditioning, Consumer Electronics, Laptops, and Apple Products for the past twenty years. With a robust distribution network boasting over 1000 touch points nationwide, the company has embraced modern retail practices by securing retail spaces in luxury malls, establishing exclusively branded stores for an unparalleled customer experience, and launching an E-commerce platform that attracts over 600,000 site visits per year.

The Role:
• Develop and maintain strong relationships with corporate clients, business partners, government institutions, and other key stakeholders.
• Act as the primary point of contact for corporate inquiries, collaborations, and partnership opportunities.
• Coordinate and support corporate meetings, presentations, events, and networking initiatives.
• Represent the company in corporate discussions, forums, and external engagements when required.
• Assist in managing corporate communications and ensuring consistent brand representation.
• Collaborate closely with internal teams such as Sales, Marketing, HR, and Finance to support corporate initiatives.
• Monitor stakeholder feedback and provide insights to improve corporate engagement strategies.
• Support contract coordination, documentation, and follow-ups related to corporate partnerships.
• Maintain accurate records of corporate interactions and relationship management activities.

The Person:
• Bachelor’s degree in Business Management, Marketing, Public Relations, Communications, or a related field.
• 1–2 years of experience in Corporate Relations, Business Development, Client Management, or a similar role.
• Strong interpersonal, communication, and negotiation skills.
• Professional presentation and relationship-building abilities.
• Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and tasks effectively.
• Proficiency in MS Office and corporate communication tools.
• Strong organizational skills with attention to detail.

Only candidates who are genuinely interested in this position are encouraged to apply.

jobs.title: Photographer / Videographer Intern
jobs.description:
Eleventh Mission is looking for a creative Photographer / Videographer to join our production team full-time.

We're looking for someone with a strong creative eye, an interest in visual storytelling, and most importantly, a willingness to learn and grow across photography, videography, and production.

Prior professional experience is not required. We're more interested in your creativity, visual sense, attitude, and potential.

The Role

During the first few months, you'll work closely with our production team, assisting on shoots and handling basic photography, videography, and editing work. As you gain experience and complete your probation period, you'll have the opportunity to take on larger projects and more creative responsibility.

You'll get exposure to a variety of productions, including commercial, lifestyle, fashion, product, social media, and other branded content.

What We're Looking For

- Strong creative and visual eye

- Interest in both photography and videography

- Basic understanding of cameras and editing is an advantage

- Willingness to learn new techniques and workflows

- Ability to work well within a production team

- Reliable and comfortable working in a fast-paced creative environment

- No prior professional experience required

Working Arrangement

Full-time, 5 days per week

Working hours: 9:30 AM – 5:00 PM

Location: Office-based

Probation: Typically 6 months

- Production schedules can occasionally require unconventional working hours, including early-morning or late-evening shoots. Additional hours worked on these productions are compensated through paid leave.

- Salary will be discussed during the interview based on skills, experience, and suitability for the role.
• Interested? Apply through LinkedIn or contact us via WhatsApp: +94 71 219 2211

jobs.title: Travel and Toursim - Intern
jobs.description:
Learn the travel industry from the inside — remotely, and get paid while you do it.

Airticka is Sri Lanka's WhatsApp-native AI travel platform. We're opening 10 places on a six-month remote internship for people who want a real career in travel and tourism — not a certificate that sits in a drawer.

You'll be trained by a travel professional with 27 years in the industry and an IATA Advanced Fares & Ticketing qualification, working on live bookings and real customers from day one.

What you'll learn

Airline fares, ticketing and reservation fundamentals
Handling real customer enquiries end to end — transfers, hotels, tours
Destination knowledge across our inbound and outbound markets
Working inside a modern travel tech stack: WhatsApp-based booking, AI-assisted service
Professional communication with travellers and overseas partners

Who it's for
School leavers and graduates who are serious about travel and tourism. No prior experience needed. You need a smartphone or laptop, reliable internet, and the discipline to work remotely without someone standing over you. English is essential; Sinhala or Tamil is an advantage.

The terms

Six months, fully remote
LKR 21,000 per month from Month 2 onward (Month 1 is intensive training)

Certificate of completion, and the strongest performers are considered for permanent roles

Places are limited to 10.

To apply, message us " I want to apply for Travel & tourism Internship program" to WhatsApp#0707152709— the screening takes about ten minutes.
